venira.avoid_when: you know the path (read_file), want a file's structure (outline_symbol), a symbol's usages (symbol_references) or an executable on PATH (shell_run: `where <name>`).
venira.output_kind: hits[] {relative_path, line_number, snippet}, complete, total_match_lines, files_matched. With queries: hits also carry score/matched, plus total_files/total_hits. No match is ok with empty hits.
venira.speed_profile: medium (file scan); TTL cache 3s for the same query.
venira.use_when: you must locate code, strings or symbols before reading. Keep relative_path narrow: a scan stops at 50000 files.

description:
Search by kind: file_name, directory_name, literal_content (regex=true for regex) or definition (symbol declarations). `queries` instead ranks matching lines by several weighted patterns (must/weight).
Use when: you must locate code, strings or symbols before reading. Keep relative_path narrow: a scan stops at 50000 files.
Avoid when: you know the path (read_file), want a file's structure (outline_symbol), a symbol's usages (symbol_references) or an executable on PATH (shell_run: `where <name>`).
Output: hits[] {relative_path, line_number, snippet}, complete, total_match_lines, files_matched. With queries: hits also carry score/matched, plus total_files/total_hits. No match is ok with empty hits.

case_sensitive.description: true makes literal_content/definition matching case-sensitive (default false).

count_only.description: true returns only match counts; limit is then ignored. false (default) returns hits.

exclude_glob.description: rg glob exclusion (same dialect as glob).

files_hint.description: Workspace paths to search when `queries` is set (first 20 are used). Omit to scan a shallow listing of `relative_path` instead.

glob.description: rg glob filter ('*.ts' = any depth, 'tools/*.ts' = that dir).

hybrid.description: true = tag hits with source/confidence; literal_content only.

include_hidden.description: true = include hidden files (default); false = skip dotfiles. Secrets always excluded.

kind.description: name substring | content (substring, or regex when regex=true) | declaration lines. Required unless `queries`/`files_hint` is set.

limit.description: Max hits returned (default and max 200; ignored when count_only=true).

queries.description: Rank matching lines by several patterns: each matching pattern adds its weight to the line's score, and `must` patterns have to match. When set, `kind` and `query` are ignored and hits carry `score`/`matched`. Combine with `files_hint` to scan specific files.

must.description: true = only lines containing this pattern count as hits (default false).

pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against each line.

weight.description: Points added to a line's score when it matches this pattern (default 1).

query.description: What to find (meaning depends on kind). Required unless `queries`/`files_hint` is set.

regex.description: true treats query as a regular expression for literal_content/definition (default false = plain substring).

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.

whole_word.description: true = whole-word match only (rg -w / JS word boundaries) for literal_content and definition.
